tasks.title: Review the six LLD design decisions
tasks.acceptance: Record the team's review of mandatory usable rPPG, nullable evidence, review guards, camera-derived templates, the C-Q comparison and outcome denominators. Resolve advisor questions in the revision log.
tasks.evidence: LLD v1 dated 16 October is available. Team/advisor acceptance is not recorded in this snapshot.

tasks.title: Verify course submissions and backlog publication
tasks.acceptance: Check the 16 October delivery record and complete the 23 October delivery checklist: LMS, required email recipients, coordinator form and public report/backlog links. Record actual submission and publication dates separately.
tasks.evidence: LLD v1 is publicly available. LMS/email/form submission is unconfirmed; a preparation date is not proof of timely submission.

tasks.title: Revise LLD with advisor feedback
tasks.acceptance: Produce LLD v2 with a dated change log. Resolve the web-first/native scope and inherited timing feasibility with the advisor; preserve the mandatory-rPPG safety rule.

tasks.title: Create a reproducible service skeleton
tasks.acceptance: A clean checkout starts the Core facade, API health route, database migration and experiment runner with pinned dependencies. Document the service boundaries and run a smoke check.

tasks.title: Define evidence and decision contracts
tasks.acceptance: Implement matching Python/TypeScript schemas for status, nullable values, score direction, reason codes and versioned snapshots. Contract tests distinguish unusable measurements, real zero values and technical errors.

tasks.title: Qualify model artifacts and adapters
tasks.acceptance: Record exact embedding/PAD weights, checksums, preprocessing, dimensions, score semantics and permitted use. Missing or incompatible manifests fail readiness; do not redistribute unapproved artifacts.

tasks.title: Implement session lifecycle and access control
tasks.acceptance: Enforce session ownership, expiry, allowed state transitions, cancellation, idempotent finalization and retry limits. Terminal sessions reject later writes and cross-user access.

tasks.title: Build browser capture and bounded transport
tasks.acceptance: Send versioned WSS packets with monotonic offsets, sequence and dimensions. Measure delivered FPS, gaps, backpressure and dropped frames; stop camera tracks and release buffers on every terminal path.

tasks.title: Implement landmarks ROI and capture quality
tasks.reference: LLD 3.3; FR-01 to FR-03 and FR-08; TC-FACE-01; TC-ROI-01
tasks.acceptance: Track one face with stable forehead/cheek ROIs and timed RGB traces. Detect invalid bounds, face changes, blur, exposure and movement. Test first with controlled fixtures, then browser captures from B08.

tasks.title: Implement face comparison and template storage
tasks.acceptance: Compare compatible embeddings from quality-selected frames. Encrypt candidate/active templates, preserve camera-capture provenance and model versions, and prevent candidate templates from authorizing returning users.

tasks.title: Integrate Visual PAD and temporal aggregation
tasks.acceptance: Run the qualified PAD adapter with exact preprocessing and deterministic sampling. Report median, lower quantile, spread and eligible counts. Separate inference errors and unusable crops from qualified attack evidence.

tasks.title: Implement POS CHROM and signal qualification
tasks.reference: LLD 3.6; FR-04 to FR-06; TC-RPPG-01 to 04
tasks.acceptance: Validate timed RGB, POS/CHROM, the configured 0.7-4 Hz filter and Welch spectrum with known signals and permitted reference data. Qualify duration, SNR and agreement; missing/unusable BPM remains null.

tasks.title: Qualify transported physiological evidence
tasks.acceptance: Compare the browser transport with a lossless research capture. Measure usable duration, timestamp gaps and compression effects before freezing minimum-rPPG criteria; record any proposed timing/profile revision.

tasks.title: Enforce enrollment and manual review guards
tasks.reference: LLD 3.8; ADR-02 and ADR-06; TC-ENROLL-01 to 04
tasks.acceptance: Activate an account/template only after biometric ACCEPT and an authorized review bound to the same candidate and snapshot. Test stale approvals, duplicate actions and prohibited overrides of REJECT/RETRY.

tasks.title: Implement the common safety gate and L1
tasks.acceptance: Test reliable-rejection precedence, technical failures, missing evidence and mandatory usable rPPG. Every actionable acceptance passes the shared gate; L1 uses a versioned validation-calibrated fixed policy.

tasks.title: Implement quality-only C-Q and attack-aware L2
tasks.acceptance: Compare C-Q and L2 on identical snapshots and common gates. Unit-test PAD temporal instability, physiology disagreement and PAD suspicion with pulse. Record pattern rule versions and their cost in Retry/coverage.

tasks.title: Bind verification to one sensitive action
tasks.acceptance: Bind successful verification to its owner, intended payout-destination change, digest and expiry. Atomically consume it once; test changed actions, expired/replayed results and concurrent double execution.

tasks.title: Connect user guidance and authorized admin views
tasks.acceptance: Render real session events, quality guidance, decisions and review state. Separate ordinary user/admin fields from consented research diagnostics, and verify authorization before event serialization.

tasks.title: Prepare permitted data and consent protocol
tasks.acceptance: Record dataset permissions, consent scope, storage/deletion rules and a fallback if access is delayed. Distinguish PAD-labelled data, physiological reference data and a paired multimodal corpus; none substitutes for the others.

tasks.title: Write the Test Plan and split manifest
tasks.acceptance: Define test IDs, fixtures/data, expected results, environments and accountable reviewers. Freeze subject/source separation and device holdouts where feasible; keep physical PAD and injection tests separate and specify all outcome denominators.

tasks.title: Build paired evidence tables and honest metrics
tasks.acceptance: Run C, C-Q and D on the same evidence and splits, with A/B limited to diagnostic controls. Count ACCEPT, REJECT, RETRY and technical outcomes over initiated attempts; report coverage and capture-to-decision latency separately from cached-policy cost.

tasks.title: Assess the L3 advisory experiment
tasks.acceptance: If the paired training data is adequate, fit regularized logistic regression with training-only preprocessing and validation-only calibration. Preserve all safety holds; otherwise record L3 as unavailable and report the limitation. XGBoost remains optional.

tasks.title: Freeze profiles and run the final evaluation
tasks.acceptance: Record the L3 availability decision, then freeze model, capture, policy and calibration manifests before opening final labels. Produce paired policy results, per-species attack outcomes, Retry/coverage, uncertainty and p50/p95 latency without retuning on test results.

tasks.title: Verify security privacy and failure handling
tasks.reference: LLD 3.8 to 3.12; TC-ENROLL-01 to 04; TC-DEMO-01; TC-DASH-01 to 03
tasks.acceptance: Verify cross-user isolation, review override prevention, single consumption, cancellation/expiry cleanup and retention. Confirm ordinary interfaces expose no raw frames, embeddings or unauthorized research diagnostics.

tasks.title: Align the public project presentation with V2
tasks.acceptance: Present the current scope, academic reports, team and evaluation plan; label the earlier scenario console as simulated. This item covers the public presentation, not the operational biometric engine or live admin application.
tasks.evidence: BioAuth master commit 5381287 and the released project website, reviewed 18 October 2026. Proposed owners do not establish past individual contribution.

tasks.title: Package Core SDK and a clean integration
tasks.acceptance: Pass a clean-environment build and sample integration with pinned dependencies, migrations, allowed model artifacts and notices. Prepare versioned Python/TypeScript packages without biometric data or secrets; confirm names/rights before registry publication.

tasks.title: Assemble the final report and team demonstration
tasks.acceptance: Report actual architecture, test-ID pass/fail evidence, measured results and limitations. Include all four members in the presentation, rehearse within 25 minutes and prepare the source/demo materials for the January date announced by the course.

tasks.title: Explore a dynamic light challenge
tasks.acceptance: Require a separate scope decision, fresh acquisition protocol and tests for interference with rPPG before implementation. Do not infer challenge results from existing recordings.

tasks.title: Explore native capture or deep rPPG
tasks.acceptance: Consider native capture and deep-rPPG as separate extensions after core evaluation and an explicit capacity/scope review. Keep OCR, NFC and document-authenticity models outside the initial scope.
tasks.evidence: No active owner or delivery promise.

tasks.title: Check short-window and transport feasibility early
tasks.acceptance: Use a small reproducible signal/capture spike to expose the five-second window, natural frequency resolution, gap and processing-budget risks before full integration. Bring feasibility findings or unresolved risks to LLD v2 review; B13 later performs full qualification.
tasks.evidence: Added in the 18 October planning revision to surface a critical dependency earlier.
